a.text: Londinium, Auchterigg Borough
Inside The Shard

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Our project is near to its close.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I hear the sound of the storm, and so do they.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They're telling me now, how they like this sound. They're dying to become a part of the storm, to howl wantonly through the air, to go and devour this hateful city before us.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Perfect.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: In ten days, our airship will be complete. From there, they'll be able to take to Londinium's skies, and serve as the storm's very pilots.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'll be going with them.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: That suits our plan. You are the optimal candidate to command our air forces, given I must be defending The Shard.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No, Theresis, that isn't what I mean.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They and I, as one, can but only go together.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Prior to their departure, you are to continue fulfilling your duty.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The Royal Court needs you, and our soldiers need their most trustworthy monarch.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Moreover, you are more proficient in building than I am, by all rights. Our construction rate has sped up by ten percent since you began attending Court meetings.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I would not forget what I am meant to do.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Also. I noticed you deposed of those... guards. The Confessarii have given you no end of grief for that, have they?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Deposing of the guards about you was the Military Commission's decision. We need more sentries, so we can answer to the greatest period of danger.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If needs be, I can enter the battlefield too.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Stay here. This tower... and the airship. Those lie at the core of our plans.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Once these two projects are through and done with, Kazdel will possess the power to fend off all nations.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Fend off all nations, you say...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've always known of your ambitions, but it makes it no less unbelievable to hear every time.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Hasn't it always plagued you that they would not permit us to rise again?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Very soon, you will be plagued no longer.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: —If even the bearing of the storm is ours to control, who would still be occupied by the dark clouds floating at its head?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: In the past, we Sarkaz let our enemies pursue us.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Time and time again we stood up in the ruins, and time again we rebuilt our homeland, and time again we watched our home be torn to shreds by the wars they incited.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Sarkaz... Sarkaz. We are a rootless people.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Why is that? Solely because they have occupied our finest soil, and forbid our roots to take.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: In the war two hundred years ago, it took all our might to drive the enemy back—yet we still could not preserve Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: After that, how much time did we have to devote, to just about reconvene our stranded remnants?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: And how much more time—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: To transport these bare shreds Victoria and Ursus could not see to a wasteland they were just as blind to, and rebuild Kazdel again right under their very noses?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Two hundred years?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Yes. It has taken us these two full centuries.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: So what of the next time? Suppose our Kazdel is once again razed by flames of war? How much more time will we need to rebuild it?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Now five hundred years—or even longer?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Our enemies have almost gotten away with this, precisely because we've become accustomed to drifting.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Ruination after ruination may never snuff out the Sarkaz soul, but it has unarguably scattered us.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Kazdel today is merely crammed with houses. It is not home.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Still more Sarkaz wander the great land beyond, no dreams in their mind's eye further than tomorrow's bread.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Even the Royal Court... All Kazdel has is its Ten Kings' Court of tradition, and the majority of those ten have left their positions vacant.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is why you wanted war.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: It is not my want, but the Sarkaz's need.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: This time, it will be beneath our feet where war's flames ignite. Victoria, Ursus, Leithanien... not one city, not one patch of soil will be fortunate enough to escape.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Within the next century, our enemies will no longer have the energy left to set their sights on Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: No, more than that. Once we have the ability to guide the storm—they'll come to fear the Sarkaz's gaze instead, just as they fear the storm descending.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The storm... gathers atop this tower we stand in.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They will see us, stood in the storm's eye. Every enemy of the Sarkaz will throw themselves at us with all they have, to stop us.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then let them.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You... Don't you fear the inferno consuming your body too, when the first thunderbolt strikes?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: When you built Babel, you too knew all opposers would point their swords at you—and did you ever once fear?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The tower you built with life has collapsed, just like another Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: And at this moment, we stand here—in a new tower, in a new opportunity.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Look at Londinium today. You only just presided over the meeting of the kings. How can you not have realized?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Not even before the useless war between us began, were the Sarkaz so close to unity.

a.text:
「I'll return to the city's outer barracks soon,
Your Majesty Theresa.」

「I understand, Nachzehrer King.
Our meeting here will be as brief as possible.」

「You're always in such a hurry, Nachzehrer.
You don't want to get together with us?」

「I haven't the time to spare, Vampire.
A hundred thousand are stationed outside Londinium.
Not I nor my soldiers can spare a second of complacency.」
「Then let's switch our duty. I'm already sick of the blabbering nobles inside the city.」
「And, Theresis, your little Gaulish friend is just as foolish and noisy as them.」
「I've got to warn you in advance. My patience is limited.」
「His head will have to stay on his neck for a moment longer. Don't add the city's Victorian Army to our troubles.」

「Fine enough. That said,
don't you feel that some still haven't been put to use?」

「Do you speak of myself, Vampire?
I have great affairs upcoming, don't I, Your Highnesses?」
「Of course. Control of Londinium is inseparable from the efforts of us all.」
「Has there been word from the Messenger you sent, Confessarius?」
「By Manfred's tireless urging, the Lich is now fast on the way to Londinium.」
「The few Wendigos left remain battling strange monsters in Ursus's north. Their hearts hold the Royal Court no more.」

「The Cyclops sends a letter. As ever, she describes a tragic scene—Londinium sundered by great fire into thirds, The Shard fallen under lightning strikes in their hundreds, and the Regent... yes, she still prophesies your end, Regent.」
「Speak.」
「She says she has seen your solitary death, on the underground throne of the Palace of Westhaleg.」
「Give her a reply, thanking her for her concern.」
「Continue searching for any sign of the Gargoyles. So long as you can find any remnant blood vessels, immediately send an invitation.」
「The Council will, together with the Royal Court, ensure victory in this war.」

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: If the Sarkaz can still be given a new chance, then that chance lies before our eyes, and it is one and only.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And very, very many will die.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: So many... Victorians, and so many Sarkaz. The people's blood will change this grey city through and through, and their wails will cover even the thunder.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: This is a war. A war between us and them, one continued for centuries, without end.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes, war... This has always been how we Sarkaz continue to survive.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: If you have any objections, speak.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Single out the dangers of my plan, just as you have countless times before.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I have no objections.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: None... you say?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If you could hear these sounds in my head, you would know, they would not allow me another choice.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Provided this war can truly free Kazdel from the cycle of destruction... Provided this storm can truly put out the Sarkaz's smoldering enmity, and return countless souls to the freedom of rest...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I will stand with you, ensuring our dream can be made reality.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: A fine turn.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: There is one more thing—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The Rhodes Islanders are already on their way.
6:50 A.M. \ Overcast
527km out from Londinium, operation platform of an abandoned mine

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, anchoring sequence will begin in T plus one hour, forty-eight minutes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good. Ensure the boarding region can operate normally before then.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Understood. We'll step up the cleanup.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Warfarin, have all critically ill patients been appropriately situated?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Relax, it's just the last three left, and we're operating on them tomorrow. We'll have the moving sickbeds arranged in no time...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Don't rush me, okay? You standing here with your stern look makes our Medic Operators have to keep peeking at you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is an emergency.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Fine, I get it, I'll quit joking.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Every day's been like a battle ever since we entered Victoria. If you hadn't transferred so many operators away beforehand...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island must operate as usual.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We reached this consensus at the first resolutive meeting, Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: No complaints from me. You made Mon3tr lash me to the side of the ship four years ago...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I mean, when you invited me to join Rhodes Island. We agreed I would research Oripathy alongside you, as a doctor.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: There wasn't any 'follow the new King of Sarkaz in a fight to win back Kazdel'-type clause in my contract, and switching Kazdel out for Londinium changes nothing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This goes for a great deal of our operators. I have no intent of forcing any one operator to participate in a mission irrelevant to their long-term goals.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Moreover, no matter the other operations we are forced to take on, we cannot turn a blind eye to the Infected throughout every region.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: *Sigh* If it wasn't for our work there, we'd have a few more elite operators to spare for this Londinium trip.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I wonder how Amiya's crew are doing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once we reach the vicinity of Londinium, we'll receive word.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Recon group, report situation on both sides!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Received. No threat, copy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, we can pass through ahead! Keep the engineering team with us!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dr.{@nickname}, still got it in you to move? Want my drones to give you a lift?

options: When were drones capable of that?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lemme think... huh, I can't actually think of anything wrong with the idea.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we just need to walk a little longer. When we're out of this danger zone, then we can ride on our crafts and recuperate a little.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll need to send Dr. Kal'tsit a message at some point, too... She must be extremely worried about us.

options: Wonder if it's going smoothly on the landship's side.
She should be sending us a message too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's exactly why she had to stay behind... she can only rendezvous with us once Rhodes Island is safely situated. That's our joint responsibility.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For safety, we can't use any messaging devices on our approach to Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Any signal might be intercepted by the Duke's force.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it might get even worse... Doctor, we can't afford to have Theresis spot us so quickly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, just leave this to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ever since we planned to drive into Victoria, Doctor Kal'tsit and you have been busy securing the safety of our route.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will take charge for the rest of it, just like we've agreed on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want a chance for you to catch your breath too... even if it's just mentally.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we have to keep going.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Ugh, there are times I think about how we got in over the past months, and it seems too smooth to even believe.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That ragtag bunch of windbags are all together in Londinium right now, and they haven't even noticed us... Kal'tsit, did you use some kind of ancient technique I'm not aware of?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If any Arts truly could render Rhodes Island invisible, believe me, I would've used them over a decade ago.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Haha, I almost forgot. 'Disused industrial mining equipment recovery organization'... is that right?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: We've been using that title for passage and permission to park the whole way. Trust Dr.{@nickname} to come up with that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr.{@nickname} tends to have a... unique angle of thought on certain aspects.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And luckily, Closure's personal interests has had her lead the Engineering Department over the past years to develop technologies for using scrap.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Which, in short, renders the title a fine one. With the addition of a few friends' aid, this plan has been successful in execution thus far.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for what comes next... that lies with Amiya and Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Two left, four right. Indra?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Check.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How's the right side?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Tsk. Someone who thought he was funny had me caught up for a second, but he's over with now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And Dagda?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I heard steel claws and crossbow bolts mashing into each other.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enemies left to the rear?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Leave 'em to her.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, there's one hiding right here—!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Now there isn't.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Just missing Dagda...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, listen, it's dead silence behind. I said she could sort it out.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Good. Vanguard group, mission complete.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Notify Amiya immediately: there's no more noble's patrols in the vicinity. They can pass through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The road ahead is clear. No casualties.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Messaging devices back in operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... we're just about to catch sight of Londinium.

options: Now can I catch my breath too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hold on, Doctor... Jessica sent a message.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... before we carry out the next step of the plan, we need to send a few operators to run a different mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have two targets to rescue. One's a friend at Blacksteel, and the other is an informant who can help us enter Londinium.
